svg.title: Melder capability ladder
svg.desc: Melder starts with binding and resolution, then adds scoped ownership, linked subsystems, isolated frames, bounded Rift access, and finally continuity and governed evolution. Higher levels are optional.

div.style: color: rgb(16, 33, 61) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1 · Bind, conjure, meld
compiled dependency world

div.style: color: rgb(16, 33, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 · Scoped ownership
conduits, lineages, spell spaces

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(21, 56, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(69, 45, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5 · Mediated live access
viewer · workstation · command

div.style: color: rgb(69, 45, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6 · Continuity + evolution
checkpoint · restore · research · notch
